textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 maths · Angles as Turns · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: A turn is how much we rotate. Turning all the way round and coming back to the start is a full turn.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A turn is how much we rotate. Turning all the way round and coming back to the start is a full turn.
beats.speakEn: A turn is how much we rotate. Turning all the way round and coming back to the start is a full turn.

beats.en: Ashutosh made a full circle by one full turn. Sahana made a half-moon shape with a half turn. The minute hand of a clock makes a full turn when it comes back to where it began.
beats.speakEn: Ashutosh made a full circle by one full turn. Sahana made a half-moon shape with a half turn. The minute hand of a clock makes a full turn when it comes back to where it began.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 maths · Angles as Turns · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Two half turns in the same direction make a full turn. Two quarter turns make a half turn and four quarter turns make a full turn.

beats.en: Two half turns in the same direction make a full turn. Two quarter turns make a half turn and four quarter turns make a full turn.
beats.speakEn: Two half turns in the same direction make a full turn. Two quarter turns make a half turn and four quarter turns make a full turn.

beats.en: Turns happen everywhere: a tap, a door on its hinge, scissors, tongs and a clothes clip. Each has a limit, such as less than a quarter turn or a half turn.
beats.speakEn: Turns happen everywhere: a tap, a door on its hinge, scissors, tongs and a clothes clip. Each has a limit, such as less than a quarter turn or a half turn.
